messages:
maria.sales: Quick check — ClinicaOne is asking for our SOC 2 excerpts, signed authorization to run an external security scan against their UAT, and the network/staging IPs for the POC. Can we cover the docs and who signs the auth letter?

nina.pss: Yep. We usually provide SOC 2 excerpt PDF + control matrix. Need to know whether they want a signed authorization from Redwood legal or a security point-of-contact signature. Also need expected scan window.

sam.security: Hi — we can provide a signed scan approval letter. I can attach template. For scope: please confirm IPs/hostnames and whether the scan includes credentialed tests. We prefer non-credentialed for POC. Draft attached:
```
To whom it may concern,
Redwood Inference authorizes external security testing against the agreed scope...
```
I'll send the PDF after they confirm CISO name. timeline: 3 business days to prep.

alex.eng: For the staging IPs — if they want a dedicated tenant/staging we can reserve a static IP range. That will bump dedicated pricing for the POC. Rough delta: +15% on monthly reserved price or +20% for a one-off isolated build. Need product approval.

nina.pss: I'll prepare dataroom folder and presigned upload link. Example presigned command:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-compliance/clinicaone/ --expires-in 86400
```

maria.sales: Great. Can we get sam to send the signed template and nina to create dataroom by EOD? Also, who from legal signs?

sam.security: I'll get the signed scan letter ready — cc: legal@redwood.com for signature. Will need the CISO name. I'll also confirm whether credentialed scan ok. :thumbsup: 

nina.pss: Dataroom link created: https://dataroom.redwood.com/clinicaone (restricted). I added SOC2 excerpt + control matrix placeholders. Will replace with final PDFs once sam sends the signed letter.

maria.sales: Perfect — I'll ask the buyer for CISO contact and confirm credentialed vs non-credentialed. I'll update here.

deploy-bot: Reminder: make sure to redact any account IDs in the SOC2 excerpt before upload. See internal checklist: https://go.redwood/internal/compliance-checklist

sam.security: Good point. Nina, please run redaction pass. I'll draft the signed PDF and post here.

nina.pss: Redaction done; will upload final artifacts after sam posts signed letter.
